summary.text: Your employer medical benefits pay first. MediShield Life can then cover the part not covered, subject to its limits.

details.heading: Payment order
details.body: Your employer medical benefits pay first. MediShield Life or an Integrated Shield Plan pays next, followed by MediSave, then cash.

details.heading: What MediShield Life covers
details.body: MediShield Life pays the part of the bill not covered by your employer, private insurance or other third-party payers. Claim limits, deductible and co-insurance apply.

example_phrasings: I am covered by Employer Medical Benefits. Can I claim from MediShield Life as well? Who pays first?
Does my employer pay before MediShield Life?
Can MediShield Life cover what my employer does not?
